title: A test run with any untracked non-ignored file in the clone records no reuse key
goal: tests.run_key leaves a run without a key when git ls-files -o --exclude-standard lists any file (not only a .py under _tools/), since conftest.seed_files copies every untracked non-ignored file into the git scenarios and the sync gate allows untracked files; a gate run after such a file was removed or edited then runs pytest instead of reusing a pass it never earned. Found by the SP-evkj4avq review in _tools/tests.py untracked_tools and run_key after ST-r7cftjex.
